propositions: rebar doctor command lacks diagnostic surface for inspecting lock hold state (held/free), holder process liveness, hold age, and staleness

Lock health audit requires read-only probes of fcntl legs (.ticket-write.lock, .rebar/hlc.lock) and mkdir leg (.ticket-write.lock.d) using existing zero-deadline lock primitives, plus v2 owner stamp decode to extract host/ns/pid/start
Holder liveness verdict must be same-host-only (reports unprobeable for foreign host or pid namespace rather than guessing pid state)
Staleness determination must exclusively reuse lock_owner._mkdir_lock_is_stale function with no independent age threshold or pid probe heuristic
Doctor lock audit produces findings only for stale locks and exits with code 1, while held locks with live holders produce no findings and exit 0
Lock health scan results are read-only and never mutated by doctor or --repair flag
